newsitem.title: UK: Lehman comments help lift Royal Sun shares.
newsitem.headline: Lehman comments help lift Royal Sun shares.

text.p: Shares in Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc were up almost two percent in early Wednesday trade, helped by positive comments from analysts at Lehman Brothers.
The shares gained 8-1/2p to 446-1/2p by 0807 GMT. Following a meeting with the insurance group on Tuesday, analyst Rob Procter said the shares had been oversold.
"In the past six weeks we've seen something like 15 percent underperformance," Procter said, adding that the shares were hit after the group's results.

"The reasons were provisioning being much higher than expected, and a poorly explained share buy-back," he said. "The doubts in some people's minds that the share buy-back will actually take place is unfair in my view."

The analyst said he expects the shares to be trading around the 500p level by the end of the year. Procter said he views the shares as a "trading buy" but maintains an official recommendation of "hold".
